component.name: ClamGuardian
component.summary: Security framework for ClamAV scanning and quarantine vaulting

description.p: ClamGuardian provides antivirus scanning, encrypted quarantine vaulting, scan profiles, a persisted scan history, and host-aware ClamAV execution for Linux.

First stable release: profile-aware scan history, SHA-256 content hashing, AES-256-GCM quarantine vault with chunked streaming, ClamAV engine integration with Flatpak-aware host execution, and a pinned dependency audit in CI.
